component.name: MetaMonitor
component.summary: Every progress bar on the desktop in one live dashboard

description.p: MetaMonitor gathers the progress of Claude Code sessions and their background commands, wrapped or piped command-line jobs, file copies and desktop applications into one GPU-drawn GTK window.
Any command enrols with mmrun, mmctl pipe or mmctl tail, or by writing a percentage into a slot file; known file-crunching commands and Claude Code sessions are picked up with no setup at all.
GRASS GIS sessions are found from their mapset locks, and every module reports its exact progress through a small preloaded library. A GNOME Shell extension puts a neon meter in the top bar.
Headless GNOME Shell test for the top-bar extension that no longer leaves an orphaned ibus-daemon behind.
GRASS GIS sessions and module progress, ~/.bashrc auto-enrolment, help guides, top-bar extension and the neon brand identity.
